ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BELLARIS.title: Bellaris
ZHIJIANG_RELIC_BELLARIS.description: At the start of each turn, gain 1 [green]Dexterity[/green] for every 15 [img]res://Zhijiang/images/characters/Bella/HeartWall_text.png[/img]. Lasts until end of turn. In [gold]Bai La[/gold] state, whenever you play a Skill, gain 1 Block, plus 1 for every 3 points of your Yin-Yang difference, and lose 1 Strength, plus 1 for every 3 points of your Yin-Yang difference, at the start of combat. In [gold]Hei La[/gold] state, whenever you play an Attack, deal 1 damage to a random enemy, plus 1 for every 3 points of your Yin-Yang difference, and lose 1 Dexterity, plus 1 for every 3 points of your Yin-Yang difference, at the start of combat.
